history.summary: Project created — web remake of the Unity game (now glyphtender-original)
Alpha — play Glyphtender in your browser: 2–4 player pass-and-play, seeds that fly and grow, score pops, tangle cues and the Magic reveal (online play waits for its server)
Play online with friends — room codes, rejoin, a robot badge when a bot takes a seat; the phone layout no longer jumps or fights your phone's gestures

The ending, polished: a Magic reveal where tangle bonuses fly in and can steal the win, an end screen with Results, Story and Scorecard, 14 skill Highlights, words that score one at a time, a plain Q, 4 players everywhere, and full screen on phones
Rebuilt on the framework Table (plays and looks the same — ready for AI); Pincer is now a hunt; online: your server-played turn glides, no false lost-move note, nothing missed when catching up

Play against the computer: 3 AI personalities and 3 skills that move like people; online, the AI fills in for idle players and hosts can add AI seats; a simpler New Game that scrolls, with arrow-key menus
A new random turn order every game, 3 players on the Small garden, 2-letter words off to start, and end-of-game awards re-tuned from thousands of AI games — with a new Super Bridge

Online, nobody waits: after 30 s of doing nothing a bar warns you, at 60 s a bot plays for you until you tap; Pause shows whether 2-letter words are on; the lobby's AI picker matches New Game; another player's draft glyphling can't be grabbed
New Game and the online lobby now start with 2-letter words off, even if you'd turned them on before

The garden sings — Glyphtender has sound: every move, throw, landing, score pop and tangle is heard, the pops climb a musical scale, a night garden of crickets and an owl with harp music that rests, and a Magic reveal that builds to a fanfare for the new Grand Glyphtender; Settings → Audio with 5 volume sliders

Dragging feels right + the Story tells the whole game — pick up one real piece (seeds and glyphlings lift, land and fly home), straight aim lines, swap seeds in the tray, the AI moves like a person; the end Story lists every player's play each round and shows when a bot played for someone
